## Demostración Varianza de la Binomial

<div class="block-proof fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div class="block-title" style="font-size: 30px;">Var(X) = np(1-p) para Bin(n,p)</div>
  <div class="block-body">
Sea $X = X_1 + \cdots + X_n$ con $X_i \sim \text{Ber}(p)$ independientes:
$$\text{Var}(X) = \sum_{i=1}^n \text{Var}(X_i) = n\,\text{Var}(X_1)$$
$$\text{Var}(X_1) = E(X_1^2) - [E(X_1)]^2 = p - p^2 = p(1-p)$$
$$\therefore \text{Var}(X) = np(1-p) \quad \square$$
  </div>
</div>
